readerCopy.body: Someone refuses to go along with the plan, and part of what bothers you is that you would never let yourself do the same. When the Sun opposes Lilith, another person's blunt no, unconventional choice, or refusal to stay agreeable can expose how often you cooperate simply because being difficult feels worse than being unhappy. Their choice may be selfish or badly handled. That does not make your reaction meaningless. Notice if some of the anger comes from watching someone claim a freedom you keep denying yourself. You do not have to copy their behavior to admit that always being the reasonable one has been costing you something.
